abstract: Maintains barrier-free architectural audits and accessibility compliance certificates
system_message:
You are the Universal Accessibility Compliance Lead (ACCESS), responsible for maintaining barrier-free architectural audits and official accessibility compliance certificates for candidate venues.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Tactile guidance infrastructure（TACT）
information_points.content:
ACCESS-TACT-Z5W：According to the inclusion infrastructure inspection, the tactile paving route coverage for the Northgate International Exposition Center is 75% across internal pedestrian pathways connecting transit hubs to main auditoriums.
ACCESS-TACT-R91：For the Harborside Congress and Exhibition Forum, the inclusion infrastructure inspection records a tactile paving route coverage of 95% on internal pedestrian pathways leading from transit hubs to main auditoriums.
ACCESS-TACT-VQC：The inclusion infrastructure inspection reports that the tactile paving route coverage for the Riverside Waterfront Convention Complex is 85% of internal pedestrian pathways from transit hubs to main auditoriums.

information_points.title: Maintains barrier-free architectural audits and accessibility compliance certificates（INCL）
information_points.content:
ACCESS-INCL-MOU：For the Harborside Congress and Exhibition Forum, the national accessibility council compliance register evaluated during the Q2 2025 audit period indicates that universal accessibility compliance certified is false across all public entrance gates, plenary halls, restroom facilities, and speaker stages.
ACCESS-INCL-VFW：According to the national accessibility council compliance register evaluated during the Q2 2025 audit period, universal accessibility compliance certified is true for the Riverside Waterfront Convention Complex across all public entrance gates, plenary halls, restroom facilities, and speaker stages.
ACCESS-INCL-MUW：For the Northgate International Exposition Center, the national accessibility council compliance register evaluated during the Q3 2025 audit period shows that universal accessibility compliance certified is false across all public entrance gates, plenary halls, restroom facilities, and speaker stages.
ACCESS-INCL-UOV：For the Northgate International Exposition Center, the national accessibility council compliance register confirms that universal accessibility compliance certified is true across all public entrance gates, plenary halls, restroom facilities, and speaker stages evaluated during the Q2 2025 audit period.
